contract.method: authored native behavior contract with independent JS reference
contract.description: Clamp fraction to [0,1], then return start + (stop - start) * clampedFraction. Start may be greater than stop. Preserve this arithmetic order.
contract.domain: Numeric arguments are finite, between -1000 and 1000, with no negative-zero inputs. Inputs are unchanged.
contract.outputRole: start plus delta times clamped fraction
contract.mutationPolicy: Do not modify inputs; array outputs must be fresh with independent storage.
